---
title: "Sampling locations and corresponding municipalities and population served"
author: "Eevi Sipponen"
---

Set the path for output, where to save figure
```{r}
output_path  = "path/to/output_dir"
```

Load libraries
```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggspatial)
```


```{r}
#get municipalities for the sampling year 2021
muni <- geofi::get_municipalities(year = 2021)

#transform the geometry to EPSG:3067 (Projected coordinate system for Finland)
muni_3067 <- st_transform(muni, 3067)

#list the municipalities to color in the map
fill_municipalities <- c("Helsinki", "Järvenpää", "Kerava", "Mäntsälä",
                         "Pornainen", "Sipoo", "Tuusula", "Vantaa",
                         "Kuopio", "Ii", "Muhos", "Oulu", "Utajärvi",
                         "Kangasala", "Lempäälä", "Pirkkala", "Tampere",
                         "Aura", "Kaarina", "Lieto","Marttila", "Mynämäki", 
                         "Naantali","Nousiainen", "Oripää", "Paimio", "Pöytyä", 
                         "Raisio","Rusko", "Turku", "Masku")

muni_3067$munip_interest <- ifelse(muni_3067$nimi %in% fill_municipalities, "Yes","No")
```

Plot the base plot
```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(muni_3067, aes(fill = munip_interest)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("Yes" = "#514289", "No" ="grey82")) +
  geom_sf(colour = scales::alpha("white", 1/3)) +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.25, unit_category = "metric", style="ticks") +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "br",
                         height = unit(1, "cm"),
                         width = unit(1, "cm"),
                         style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering) +
  coord_sf() +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank())

```

Add city annotation labels to the base plot
```{r}
#Helsinki
H_name <- "Pornainen"

H_pt <- muni_3067 %>%
  filter(.data[["nimi"]] == H_name) %>%
  st_point_on_surface() %>%
  st_coordinates() %>%
  as.data.frame()
names(H_pt) <- c("x", "y")

H_x <- H_pt$x + 100000
H_y <- H_pt$y + 80000


#Kuopio
K_name <- "Kuopio"

K_pt <- muni_3067 %>%
  filter(.data[["nimi"]] == K_name) %>%
  st_point_on_surface()%>%
  st_coordinates() %>%
  as.data.frame()
names(K_pt) <- c("x", "y")

K_x <- K_pt$x + 120000
K_y <- K_pt$y + 40000 

#Oulu
O_name <- "Oulu"

O_pt <- muni_3067 %>%
  filter(.data[["nimi"]] == O_name) %>%
  st_point_on_surface() %>%
  st_coordinates() %>%
  as.data.frame()
names(O_pt) <- c("x", "y")

O_x <- O_pt$x - 140000
O_y <- O_pt$y


#Tampere
TA_name <- "Tampere"

TA_pt <- muni_3067 %>%
  filter(.data[["nimi"]] == TA_name) %>%
  st_point_on_surface() %>%
  st_coordinates() %>%
  as.data.frame()
names(TA_pt) <- c("x", "y")

TA_x <- TA_pt$x - 80000
TA_y <- TA_pt$y + 100000

#Turku
TU_name <- "Mynämäki"

TU_pt <- muni_3067 %>%
  filter(.data[["nimi"]] == TU_name) %>%
  st_point_on_surface() %>%
  st_coordinates() %>%
  as.data.frame()
names(TU_pt) <- c("x", "y")

TU_x <- TU_pt$x - 110000
TU_y <- TU_pt$y + 50000



p2 <- p1 +
  annotate("segment", x = H_x, y = H_y,
           xend = H_pt$x, yend = H_pt$y,
           linewidth = 0.3, color = "black")+
  annotate("label",
           x = H_x, y = H_y,
           label = "Helsinki\n860,000", size = 3, fill = "white") +
  annotate("segment",
           x = K_x, y = K_y,
           xend = K_pt$x, yend = K_pt$y,
           linewidth = 0.3, color = "black") +

  annotate("label",
           x = K_x, y = K_y,
           label = "Kuopio\n91,000", size = 3, fill = "white") +
  annotate("segment",
           x = O_x, y = O_y,
           xend = O_pt$x, yend = O_pt$y,
           linewidth = 0.3, color = "black") +

  annotate("label",
           x = O_x, y = O_y,
           label = "Oulu\n200,000", size = 3, fill = "white") +
  annotate("segment",
           x = TA_x, y = TA_y,
           xend = TA_pt$x, yend = TA_pt$y,
           linewidth = 0.3, color = "black") +

  annotate("label",
           x = TA_x, y = TA_y,
           label = "Tampere\n200,000", size = 3, fill = "white") +
  annotate("segment",
           x = TU_x, y = TU_y,
           xend = TU_pt$x, yend = TU_pt$y,
           linewidth = 0.3, color = "black") +

  annotate("label",
           x = TU_x, y = TU_y,
           label = "Turku\n300,000", size = 3, fill = "white") 

ggsave(p2, file = paste0(output_path, "Figures/sampling_locations_purple.jpg"), 
       width=3, height=5, dpi=300)
```
